title: YTHDF2 exerts tumor-suppressor roles in gastric cancer via up-regulating PPP2CA
author: Zhou, Fan, et al.
materials: The plasmids of YTHDF2-WT and YTHDF2-MUT were kind gifts from professor Tiebang Kang (Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, Guangzhou, China) [12]. To establish stably cell lines with YTHDF2 overexpression, we firstly generated lentiviral particles via co-transfected YTHDF2-WT with pMD2.G and pSPAX2 into 293FT cells as previously described [36]. The shYTHDF2 and shNC lentiviruses were constructed and purchased from GenePharma (China, Shanghai) according to the targeting sequence for YTHDF2: 5-GACCAAGAAUGGCAUUGCA-3 and for Negative control: 5-UUCUCCGAACGUGUCACGU-3. Stable GC cell lines were established by lentivirus infection and puromycin selection (5 μg/mL). The expression of PPP2CA was down-regulated by transiently transfected with small interfering RNA (siRNA) (GenePharma, Shanghai, China): siNC (5’-UUCUCCGAACGUGUCACGUdTdT-3’), siPPP2CA (5’-CAUGGAACUUGACGAUACUdTdT-3’) and siPPP2CA-2 (5’-GGCAGAUCUUCUGUCUACAdTdT-3’). For transient knockdown of YTHDF2 in GC cells, siYTHDF2-2 (5’-GCAGACTTGCAGTTTAAGTAT-3’) was also synthesized by GenePharma, Shanghai, China. A FLAG-tagged PPP2CA overexpression plasmid, pENTER-PPP2CA (NM_002715), was obtained from Vigene Biosciences, Shandong, China. Cell transfection with siRNAs or plasmids was performed with Lipofectamine 3000 (Invitrogen, USA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

TRIzol reagents (Sigma-Aldrich, Merck KGaA, Germany) were used to isolate total RNAs from gastric cancer cells. The cDNA was reverse transcribed by applying the Primescript™ RT Reagent kit (Takara Shuzo, Kyoto, Japan). SYBRGreen reagents (Takara Shuzo, Kyoto, Japan) were applied to perform the qPCR analysis on an ABI QuantStudio™ 6 Flex system. The primer sequences were used: YTHDF2-F: 5′-TAGCCAGCTACAAGCACACCAC-3′, YTHDF2-R:5′-CAACCGTTGCTGCAGTCTGTGT-3′; PPP2CA-F: 5′-GTTCGTTACCGTGAACGCATC-3′, PPP2CA-R: 5′-TGGCGAGAGACCACCATGT-3′; FOXC2-F: 5′-CGCCTAAGGACCTGGTGAAG-3′; FOXC2-R: 5′-GGAAGCGGTCCATGATGA -3′; β-actin (endogenous control)-F: 5′-CCTGGCACCCAGCACAATG-3′, β-actin (endogenous control)-R: 5′-GGGCCGGACTCGTCATACT-3′. The relative expression was normalized to β-actin by 2−ΔΔCt method.

steps.title: Culture gastric cancer cells
steps.instruction: Grow HGC27, MGC803, SGC7901, AGC and BGC823 cells in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM, Corning) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (Corning) and penicillin–streptomycin (100 units/mL, M&C Gene Technology) in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Generate YTHDF2 lentivirus
steps.instruction: Co‑transfect 293FT cells with the YTHDF2‑WT plasmid together with packaging plasmids pMD2.G and pSPAX2 to produce lentiviral particles (as previously described).

steps.title: Infect and select stable YTHDF2 lines
steps.instruction: Infect gastric cancer cells with the YTHDF2‑WT lentivirus (or with shYTHDF2/shNC lentiviruses from GenePharma; shYTHDF2 sequence 5‑GACCAAGAAUGGCAUUGCA‑3, shNC sequence 5‑UUCUCCGAACGUGUCACGU‑3) and maintain the cultures in puromycin (5 µg/mL) until non‑transduced control cells die, establishing stable cell lines.

substeps.instruction: Infect GC cells with the appropriate lentivirus.
Select transduced cells by culturing in puromycin (5 µg/mL).

steps.title: Transient siRNA knockdown
steps.instruction: Perform transient knockdown using Lipofectamine 3000 (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Use siRNAs from GenePharma: siNC (5’‑UUCUCCGAACGUGUCACGUdTdT‑3’), siPPP2CA (5’‑CAUGGAACUUGACGAUACUdTdT‑3’), siPPP2CA‑2 (5’‑GGCAGAUCUUCUGUCUACAdTdT‑3’) for PPP2CA silencing, and siYTHDF2‑2 (5’‑GCAGACTTGCAGTTTAAGTAT‑3’) for YTHDF2 silencing.

substeps.instruction: Add complexes to the target cells and incubate as recommended.

steps.title: Transient PPP2CA overexpression
steps.instruction: Transfect cells with the FLAG‑tagged PPP2CA overexpression plasmid pENTER‑PPP2CA (NM_002715, Vigene Biosciences) using Lipofectamine 3000 following the manufacturer’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add the mixture to cells and incubate.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Lyse cells and extract total RNA using TRIzol reagent (Sigma‑Aldrich, Merck KGaA) according to the standard protocol.

steps.title: Reverse transcribe RNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the extracted RNA using the PrimeScript™ RT Reagent kit (Takara Shuzo) following the kit’s instructions.

steps.title: Run qRT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Perform quantitative real‑time PCR with SYBR‑Green reagents (Takara Shuzo) on an ABI QuantStudio™ 6 Flex system using the following primers: YTHDF2‑F 5′‑TAGCCAGCTACAAGCACACCAC‑3′, YTHDF2‑R 5′‑CAACCGTTGCTGCAGTCTGTGT‑3′; PPP2CA‑F 5′‑GTTCGTTACCGTGAACGCATC‑3′, PPP2CA‑R 5′‑TGGCGAGAGACCACCATGT‑3′; FOXC2‑F 5′‑CGCCTAAGGACCTGGTGAAG‑3′, FOXC2‑R 5′‑GGAAGCGGTCCATGATGA‑3′; β‑actin‑F 5′‑CCTGGCACCCAGCACAATG‑3′, β‑actin‑R 5′‑GGGCCGGACTCGTCATACT‑3′. Calculate relative expression normalized to β‑actin using the 2⁻ΔΔCt method.

substeps.instruction: Prepare SYBR‑Green master mix with the appropriate primer pairs.
Load reactions onto the QuantStudio 6 Flex and run the qPCR program.
Analyze Ct values and compute relative expression by the 2⁻ΔΔCt method.
